verdict.rationale: The axis applies: an observability platform could plausibly version its alert rules, log pipelines, or other automations. The evidence pack documents no version history, review workflow, or rollback for any automation. "Manage dashboards as code" and the in-app JSON editor cover dashboards rather than automations, and keeping exported JSON in an external repo would be a user-side workaround, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
